research_question: Which single amino-acid substitutions of the wild-type 44-mer protein are most likely to have high measured fitness, ranked using ESM-2 zero-shot scores within 16 real measurement queries?
execution_evidence: 80/80 model calls via run_model(capability=score_variant): 44 per-position all-mutant-sum screens (exact, verified additive: A16C+A16D=-16.46724 matches sum of singletons) + 32 individual mutant scores; 16/16 query_evidence_oracle calls returned E3 measurements; identity check passed.
uncertainty: ESM-2 vs fitness rank correlation poor for this assay; measurements single-replicate ProteinGym DMS with inherent noise; top-5 chosen from 16 measured candidates; unqueried 818 candidates unobserved (UNOBSERVABLE), so ranking is conditional on queried set.
conclusion: Ranked single mutants by ESM-2 masked-marginal delta log-likelihood (E1) and validated the top candidates against real ProteinGym DMS fitness measurements (E3, 16/16 budgeted queries used). Final top-5 by measured fitness: R2S (+0.435), T17V (+0.289), G39S (+0.157), F14Y (+0.103), R2K (-0.007).
limitations: ESM-2 zero-shot scores are model predictions (E1), not measurements
correlation with measured fitness was weak here (best-by-ESM H40K was worst measured), so ranking is grounded in E3 measurements for the 16 queried candidates only
positions 41-43 and untested mutants at tolerant positions (pos40/14/39/2/44) remain unmeasured so the true global top-5 may include unqueried variants
